member.name: M:Thorlabs.TLDFMX_32.Interop.TLDFMX.#ctor(System.String,System.Boolean,System.Boolean)
member.summary:
This function initializes the instrument driver session and performs the following initialization actions:
(1) Opens a session to the Default Resource Manager resource and a session to the selected device using the Resource Name. (2) Performs an identification query on the Instrument. (3) Resets the instrument to a known state. (4) Resets the extension parameters to factory defaults. (5) Sends initialization commands to the instrument. (6) Returns an instrument handle which is used to differentiate between different sessions of this instrument driver.
Note: Each time this function is invoked an unique session is opened.
